column1: # The radio plugin's station list: what every iSekur fetches (every `refresh` hours, 24 by default).
# One station per line: name <TAB> address. An address is a YouTube channel's live (https://www.youtube.com/@name/live: always
# its current stream) or a plain http(s) radio stream. Lines starting with # are comments.
# radio/check.py tests every station and moves the dead ones to removed.tsv (and back when they work again): don't edit by hand
# what it just wrote, send a line to add a station. See radio/README.md.
